avis.titre: Acne scars faded in just 1 use! Super soft smooth skin!! WOW
avis.texte: I have only used this twice but it's SO AMAZING I had to come and write a review because I am seriously blown away!! I am 41, and have always wanted to try retinol but am afraid of the side effects, so I gave Beekman's Bakuchiol serum a go after reading it was a more gentle yet effective alternative. I did have some light, intermittent face itching with the first use, but I admittedly used 3-4 drops instead of the recommended 1-2. However, I also read that a little light itching is normal when trying something new with active ingredients. In just ONE application, my acne scars on my right cheek are almost gone - I can't even believe it! My entire face looks plumper, younger, healthier, smile lines less prominent, more even tone/less redness, pimples clearing up, and my skin feels as smooth as a baby's butt. It's a miracle in a bottle FR!! So impressed with the results after just two uses that I already went out and bought another bottle. This is an absolute game changer - give it a try, you won't regret it!

In a search for a dupe for a more expensive serum, I found this and I have purchased around three times already and will continue to do so. It's inexpensive, especially for the quality. It's good on my redness, prone skin and gives me a glowy finish each time. I really love it!

I bought this during the 50% off sale & am totally loving how well it works w/ my moisturizer. I have dry skin which is now plumped & glowing!!! This is worth the price. Using a drop or two with moisturizer means that it lasts a long time…

I don't know definitely not something I would buy again especially for full price. the bottle itself is very small looks like hardly anything in it. my face feels gross after applying and it broke me out within 24 hours of use!
Gave it a shot and glad i did! A little goes a long way and it really absorbs nicely. I have very sensitive skin even in my mid 30's and doesn't irritate me or break me out.

One thing people don't realize is bakuchiol is NOT a retinol (despite commonly being called a "phyto-retinol"). This means you may not get the same results you would by using a retinol product, however you are also less likely to have any of the adverse side effects associated with a retinol (especially for sensitive skin). It is anti-inflammatory and has both antioxidant and antibacterial properties. I have eczema prone, acne prone, combo skin that can be very picky and this worked wonderfully. I use this on my last recovery night ("skin cycling") with a THICK moisturizer. I typically mix it with the moisturizer or apply it on top due to its oily consistency so it traps in water based products but it leaves my skin less red, more even, and glowing every time I use it. As always patch test and don't over use it at first, but I have seen great results with this and will be repurchasing.

But if you want the product that uses natural ingredients and has a gentle yet potent formula, this is IT. I have tried so many products to convert my skin into the beautiful "no-makeup-model" kind of look, and none have worked the way this does. And none have felt as good. I've used Acutane, Proactive, Doxycycline, Clara, and all sorts of random drug store products. They all excuse my burning skin or increased breakouts as an issue with my "combination skin," but I'm pretty sure we all have combination skin so it's beyond nice to find a product that just WORKS because it was made to help, not to sell. I am a HUGE fan.
